servicesSection.title: Everything Your Farm Needs Within 10–15 km
servicesSection.subtitle: Search verified machinery, skilled farm crews, and post-harvest infrastructure sorted by real distance.
servicesSection.machineryDesc: Tractors, harvesters, rotavators, tillers, seeders, sprayers, and ploughs with clear hourly, daily, or per-acre rates.
servicesSection.labourDesc: Post labour requests or hire skilled crews for harvesting, sowing, land preparation, weeding, spraying, and irrigation.
servicesSection.facilitiesDesc: Locate nearby warehouses, cold storages, drying units, sorting, grading, and packaging facilities with live available capacity.

howSection.title: From Search to Service in Three Steps
howSection.step1Desc: Use device GPS in one tap or pick an approximate region. AgriConnect calculates real Haversine distances within a 5–25 km radius.
howSection.step2Desc: Request farm workers by daily wage, or book nearby machinery and cold storage with an instant transparent cost estimate.
howSection.step3Desc: Accept local worker confirmations or track provider approvals right from your mobile-friendly dashboard.

testimonials.title: Stories from Rural Collaborators

items.name: Rajesh Patil
items.quote: Finding a combine harvester within 8 km used to take two days of phone calls. On AgriConnect I compared rates and got confirmation in under an hour.

items.name: Suresh Deshmukh
items.role: Tractor & Rotavator Owner, Malegaon Bk (Sample Review)
items.quote: My tractor used to sit idle between sowing cycles. Now nearby farmers book slots directly, keeping utilization high throughout the season.

items.name: Vikram Kulkarni
items.role: Cold Storage Operator, MIDC Baramati (Sample Review)
items.quote: Farmers see our live remaining cold storage capacity before arriving, which prevents spoilage and makes intake scheduling predictable.

about.title: Bridging Rural Agriculture Through Hyperlocal Coordination
about.subtitle: AgriConnect connects Indian farmers directly with nearby tractor owners, skilled farm workers, and post-harvest storage facilities.
about.missionDesc: Every sowing and harvest window is time-critical. AgriConnect removes middlemen and phone-tag delays by showing real nearby availability, transparent daily wages, and clear storage capacity.
about.pillar1Desc: Six regional Indian languages, instant mobile profile identification, large buttons, and an isolated interactive demo mode.
about.pillar2Desc: One-tap GPS pinpointing with Haversine distance sorting so farmers find services within 5–25 km.
about.pillar3Desc: Equipment owners, labour crews, and cold storage operators increase utilization without commission barriers.

howItWorks.title: How AgriConnect Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple digital coordination for farmers, farm workers, machinery owners, and storage operators.
farmerSteps: Choose your regional language (English, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, or Marathi).
Enter your full name and 10-digit mobile number to open or resume your profile.
Capture your farm GPS location in one tap or select your village and district.
Post a labour request with daily wage, or book nearby machinery and cold storage.
Track accepted workers and manage bookings live from your Farmer Dashboard.
providerSteps: Create your Worker, Equipment Owner, or Facility Operator profile.
Browse nearby open farmer labour requests sorted by distance and daily wage.
Tap Accept Request to confirm your work slot immediately and unlock farmer contact details.
List tractors, harvesters, or storage capacity with transparent rates and availability.
Update job progress and build trust through completed bookings.
